ownerRulesPreserved: same valid key proof maps to same identity from any program
scope: request key-possession proof only; not connector messages, enrollment/disable certificates or transport encryption

wireEnvelope.base64: URL-safe RFC4648, no padding/whitespace, decode then exact re-encode equality
wireEnvelope.parse: strict UTF8, duplicate/unknown fields rejected, no repeated action/target/args shadow fields outside frame

frame.fieldEncoding: each field below: length U32BE then exact bytes; fixed order, no optional omissions, no trailing bytes
frame.asciiRule: visible ASCII0x21..0x7e only; semantic action/scope/key schemas checked separately
frame.u63be: 8-byte big-endian, sign bit zero; no floating point/string conversion
frame.args: sign the exact original UTF8 JSON bytes; strict single DTO parse rejects duplicate keys/unknown fields/type coercion before dispatch; never JSONObject reserialize for signature

signature.publicKey: strict P256 X509 SPKI from compiled principal registry or validated low delegation
signature.encoding: strict DER SEQUENCE of minimal positive INTEGER r,s, each1..n-1; 8..72bytes; signature is outside signed frame
signature.malleability: both valid s and n-s represent same key proof; nonce/challenge identity, NOT signature-byte hash, prevents replay. Do not manufacture caller-source distinctions.
signature.notAuthorization: successful ECDSA establishes key possession only, never client-claimed level/role/scope

challengeAdmission.clock: target elapsedRealtime and server-issued stored deadline; client cannot extend by changing signed number; serverInstanceNonce changes on control-server restart
order: bounded strict parse/field and curve checks
match actual target/stored challenge and monotonic deadline
recheck enabled principal/current policy revision/delegation/scope/owner grant/source-data gate
atomic admission consumes nonce and reserves or returns same idempotency job before dispatch
challengeAdmission.nonce: server CSPRNG32bytes, challengeId16bytes; exact nonce consumed once; invalid signature never consumes another principal's challenge
challengeAdmission.idempotency: (principal,target,dataEpoch,requestId) fixes one action/scope/args digest; same content with fresh proof returns original job, different content conflicts; consumed old proof is REPLAY, not an authorization bypass
challengeAdmission.unknownEffect: timeout/disconnect/unknown cloud outcome never starts a second route or repeats effect; query same job with fresh authorized proof
challengeAdmission.ownerWait: highest-risk no-grant request obtains no sufficient authority; owner grant changes proof binding so reissue challenge, not upgrade an already signed frame
challengeAdmission.delegation: all-zero digest iff direct compiled identity/no delegation bundle; otherwise SHA256 exact bounded validated delegation bundle. Certificate byte format remains separate pending work.

dummyVectors: public scalar1 P256 test fixture only, never a real administrator/release/device credential
